name: AMD HD3D
summary: AMD's open-standard 3D platform for Radeon GPUs. Unlike Nvidia 3D Vision, provided an API for native developer implementation rather than a universal wrapper. Required middleware like TriDef or iZ3D for non-native games. Games with native support include Deus Ex: Human Revolution, Dirt 3, and Sleeping Dogs.
compatibility_notes: Requires legacy Catalyst 15.7.1 or Crimson 16.2.1 Beta drivers. Compatible AMD hardware: HD 7000, Rx 200, non-Polaris Rx 300 series. Windows 10 2004+ introduced WDDM 2.7 with strict driver signing enforcement, causing legacy Catalyst drivers to BSOD. HD3D code remains in modern Adrenalin drivers but is disabled and cannot initialize on RDNA GPUs.
hardware_requirements: AMD Radeon HD 7000, Rx 200, or non-Polaris Rx 300 series
